subject: Science
text: What is the primary function of guard cells in the epidermis of leaves?
explanation: Guard cells swell or shrink to regulate the opening and closing of stomatal pores, controlling gas exchange and water loss.

options.text: To regulate the opening and closing of stomata.
To store starch and other plant carbohydrates.
To transport water from the root to the leaf.
To absorb carbon dioxide directly from the soil.

subject: Science
text: Which organic acid is naturally present in tamarind?
explanation: Tamarind contains tartaric acid, which gives it a strong sour taste.

subject: Science
text: What is the chemical name and formula of Plaster of Paris?
explanation: Plaster of Paris is calcium sulphate hemihydrate, with the chemical formula \text{CaSO}_4 \cdot \frac{1}{2}\text{H}_2\text{O}.

subject: Science
text: Which device is used to change the resistance in an electric circuit without changing the voltage source?
explanation: A rheostat (variable resistor) is used to regulate current by varying the resistance in a circuit without changing the source voltage.

subject: Science
text: The focal length of a convex mirror of radius of curvature 32 cm is:
explanation: Focal length f = R/2. For a convex mirror, both radius and focal length are positive, so f = +32/2 = +16 cm.

subject: Science
text: Who proposed the 10% law of energy transfer in a food chain?
explanation: Raymond Lindeman proposed the 10% law, which states that only 10% of the energy is transferred to the next trophic level.

subject: Science
text: The transport of soluble products of photosynthesis in plants is called:
explanation: Translocation is the transport of soluble products of photosynthesis (food/sucrose) through phloem tissue from leaves to other parts of the plant.

subject: Science
text: Which type of mirror is used by dentists to see large images of patients' teeth?
explanation: A concave mirror forms an erect, virtual, and magnified image when the object is placed close to the mirror (between focus and pole).

subject: Science
text: Which non-metal exists as a liquid at room temperature?
explanation: Bromine (\text{Br}) is the only non-metal that is liquid at room temperature.

subject: Science
text: When carbon dioxide is passed through lime water, it turns milky. On passing excess carbon dioxide, this milkiness disappears due to the formation of:
explanation: Excess \text{CO}_2 converts insoluble calcium carbonate (\text{CaCO}_3) into soluble calcium hydrogen carbonate [\text{Ca(HCO}_3)_2], clearing the solution.

subject: Science
text: What is the growth movement of plant parts in response to touch or contact called?
explanation: Thigmotropism is directional growth movement in response to touch, commonly seen in the winding of tendrils around a support.

subject: Science
text: Which plant hormone inhibits growth and promotes leaf fall and wilting?
explanation: Abscisic acid is a plant growth inhibitor hormone that promotes wilting, senescence, and leaf abscission.

subject: Science
text: The S.I. unit of electric potential difference is:
explanation: The S.I. unit of electric potential difference is the volt (V). It represents the work done per unit charge.

subject: Science
text: Why do mammals and birds need a complete separation of oxygenated and deoxygenated blood through double circulation?
explanation: It prevents mixing of blood and provides highly efficient oxygen supply to maintain a constant body temperature (warm-blooded nature).

options.text: To maintain constant body temperature in warm-blooded animals by efficient oxygenation.
To prevent backflow of blood into the veins.
To allow carbon dioxide to be excreted through skin.
To reduce the heart rate during sleep.

subject: Science
text: Why do ionic compounds generally have high melting and boiling points?
explanation: Ionic compounds are formed of ions held by strong electrostatic forces of attraction, which require a large amount of energy to break.

options.text: Because of strong electrostatic forces of attraction between oppositely charged ions.
Because they contain weak intermolecular covalent bonds.
Because they are highly soluble in organic solvents.
Because they contain free electrons in solid state.

subject: Science
text: Which equation represents the correct chemical reaction of iron reacting with steam?
explanation: Iron reacts only with steam (hot water) to form magnetic iron oxide (iron II,III oxide) and hydrogen gas: 3\text{Fe} + 4\text{H}_2\text{O}(g) \rightarrow \text{Fe}_3\text{O}_4 + 4\text{H}_2.

subject: Science
text: The refractive index of water is 4/3. What is the speed of light in water?

subject: Science
text: What is a solenoid, and how does the magnetic field inside it behave when current is passed?
explanation: A solenoid is a cylindrical coil of insulated copper wire. The magnetic field inside it consists of parallel straight lines, indicating it is uniform.

options.text: A cylindrical coil of wire; field inside is uniform and represented by parallel straight lines.
A flat circular loop of wire; field inside is zero.
A straight conducting wire; field inside is concentric circles.
A permanent magnet; field inside flows from south to north.

subject: Science
text: Why does anaerobic respiration in yeast yield ethanol, while in human muscle cells it yields lactic acid?
explanation: Yeast cells contain enzymes that perform alcoholic fermentation, converting pyruvate to ethanol and \text{CO}_2. Muscles perform lactic acid fermentation due to temporary oxygen lack.

options.text: Yeast has enzymes for alcoholic fermentation; muscles perform lactic acid fermentation due to oxygen lack.
Yeast performs respiration in presence of carbon dioxide; muscles require nitrogen.
Muscles lack mitochondria to convert pyruvate to ethanol.
Yeast is multicellular and has a simpler metabolic pathway than muscle cells.

subject: Science
text: Why do stars twinkle at night, whereas planets do not?
explanation: Stars are point sources of light whose rays suffer continuous variations in refraction due to moving atmospheric layers. Planets are closer, extended sources, so variations average out.

options.text: Stars are point sources whose refraction varies continuously; planets are extended sources where variations average out.
Stars emit variable light intensities; planets reflect constant solar light.
Stars are located outside our galaxy; planets are within the solar system.
Atmospheric dust scatters starlight but absorbs light reflected from planets.

subject: Science
text: What is the primary environmental impact of burning fossil fuels, and why is it necessary to switch to renewable energy sources?
explanation: Fossil fuels release greenhouse gases (\text{CO}_2) and polluting acidic oxides (nitrogen/sulphur), causing global warming and acid rain, and they are non-renewable.

options.text: They release greenhouse gases and acidic oxides, cause global warming/acid rain, and are non-renewable.
They increase atmospheric oxygen levels leading to forest fires.
They deplete the ozone layer directly by releasing chlorofluorocarbons.
They cause rapid cooling of the earth's surface due to soot formation.

subject: Science
text: An organic compound 'A' (\text{C}_2\text{H}_6\text{O}) is oxidized by heating with alkaline potassium permanganate to form compound 'B' (\text{C}_2\text{H}_4\text{O}_2). Identify A and B.
explanation: Ethanol (\text{C}_2\text{H}_5\text{OH}, formula \text{C}_2\text{H}_6\text{O}) is oxidized by alkaline \text{KMnO}_4 to form ethanoic acid (\text{CH}_3\text{COOH}, formula \text{C}_2\text{H}_4\text{O}_2).

subject: Science
text: Explain how blood groups are inherited in human beings.
explanation: Inheritance is controlled by gene I which has three alleles: I^A, I^B, and I^O. I^A and I^B are co-dominant, and both are dominant over I^O.

options.text: Controlled by gene I with three alleles where I^A and I^B are co-dominant, and both dominate over I^O.
Controlled by two genes on separate sex chromosomes, displaying sex-linked inheritance.
Determined entirely by maternal inheritance and mitochondrial DNA.
Follows simple incomplete dominance where heterozygous genotype gives intermediate phenotype.

subject: Science
text: A student sitting on the last bench cannot see the blackboard clearly. What is the eye defect and what are its physiological causes?
explanation: The student has Myopia. It is caused by: (1) excessive curvature of the eye lens, or (2) elongation of the eyeball, focusing images in front of the retina.

options.text: Myopia; caused by excessive curvature of the eye lens or elongation of the eyeball.
Hypermetropia; caused by eye lens becoming too flat or eyeball shortening.
Presbyopia; caused by weakening of ciliary muscles and loss of flexibility.
Myopia; caused by loss of transparency of the cornea.

subject: Science
text: A resistor of 5 \Omega is connected in series with a parallel combination of two resistors of 6 \Omega and 3 \Omega. Calculate the equivalent resistance of the entire combination.
explanation: Parallel combination equivalent: R_p = (6 \times 3) / (6 + 3) = 18/9 = 2 \, \Omega. Total series equivalent: R_eq = 5 + R_p = 5 + 2 = 7 \, \Omega.
